questions.q: What four traits are most common among highly sensitive persons?
a: Deep processing, detail focus, high empathy, overstimulation
questions.why: Lists the four traits described in the overview.

questions.q: According to Dr Aron, high sensitivity often co-occurs with which conditions?
questions.why: Mentions genetic link with ADHD and/or introversion.

questions.q: What metaphor does the book use to help Clark Kent control his senses?
a: His mother tells him to make the world small
He is taught to count to ten
questions.why: Reference to the Superman scene where his mom says 'make the world small.'

questions.q: Why is overstimulation considered the most costly trait for HSPs?
a: It can overwhelm them despite other strengths
It eliminates their attention to detail
questions.why: Explains that overstimulation torpedoes inner balance despite other benefits.

questions.q: What strategy does Dr Aron suggest HSPs use to navigate social expectations?
a: Create a conscious persona for society
questions.why: Describes crafting a persona to smooth social life.
